title: Bounded raw channel overrides

domain.defaultBehavior: none; closed allowlist, max 200 entries, fails closed

compatibility: escape hatch, not the model: every recurring override is a candidate for a real capability

calibration.staticDoorNote: STRUCTURALLY_UNREACHABLE (DT ruling, F4B-17). BrandTheme.tokenOverrides (the field the registry's staticBrandThemePath names) is declared on the type but never read by compileBrandTheme -- 0 property-access occurrences of `.tokenOverrides` anywhere in infrastructure/compilers/kernel/runtime/brand-theme/index.ts, verified this packet by direct grep against the live tree. The only reachable slot under a similar name, BrandCompilerInput.verticalTokenOverrides, is a SEPARATE compiler-input parameter carrying the VERTICAL's own baseline structural overrides (TenantTokenOverrides: surface/motion, not the raw --ds-* map) -- writing there would measure the wrong actor, the H-1 class the DT ruling names. Full chain, both cases and the consequence of each false path: test-artifacts/quality-evidence/wo-cra-23/F4B/token-overrides/static-door.STRUCTURALLY-UNREACHABLE.json (unreceipted by design, same law as responsive.posture's own precedent -- stronger here, since the field has no reader at all, for any caller).
calibration.domainKindGapNote: STOP -- reported, not worked around. `domain.kind` for this control is derived from the registry's `valueType: 'token-map'` (manifest/generator/index.mjs:186 falls through enumValues/bounds to the raw valueType when neither is set). `ingressValueForStop` (runtime/ingress/index.mjs:921-1059) recognises exactly five kinds -- closed-enum, bounded, profile-id, font-stack, color-set -- and throws `DOMAIN_KIND_NOT_LOWERED` for anything else, `token-map` included. This is NOT specific to this control's channel choice: grep confirms `chrome.families` (`domain.kind: 'chrome-map'`) is in the SAME unrecognised state and is still calibration.assessmentState `UNKNOWN` with zero normalizedStops -- no packet in this programme has yet lowered a map-shaped domain through the standard causal CLI. A brace-set ingress path CAN name one specific allowlisted channel as its own door (`visualFoundation.advanced.tokenOverrides.{--ds-color-error,--ds-color-bg-overlay}`, resolveIngressMember selects by last-segment role exactly as it does for `palette.{...}`) and `color-set`'s branch would lower a hex value at it correctly -- verified by reading, not yet by running. But making that work requires the registry's `valueType` to read `color-set` instead of `token-map`, which RECLASSIFIES how this control's domain is characterised system-wide (this control's true domain is a 200-entry heterogeneous map: colors, font stacks, numbers -- 'color-set' would only be honest for the two channels this packet chose to test, not for the control). That is a design decision about domain taxonomy, not a mechanical implementation of the already-adjudicated ruling this brief authorises -- and touching `capabilities/index.ts` at all restales the ~130 live receipts and requires the closing-lane coordination the DT's own dispatch named (never simultaneous with Opus's concurrent packet). Escalated rather than decided unilaterally. Two DB-side findings below (`dbSideMeasuredNote`, `staticDoorNote`) stand regardless of how this is adjudicated: they were measured by a direct dist/server.js compile, no causal CLI, no instrument dependency.
calibration.dbSideMeasuredNote: Measured directly (hydrateTenantThemeConfig -> compileTenantThemeConfig against dist/server.js, this packet, all 3 verticals), NOT through the causal CLI (blocked, see domainKindGapNote). `visualFoundation.advanced.tokenOverrides: {'--ds-color-error': '#123456'}` moves `--ds-color-error` cleanly on all 3 verticals; rottay ALSO moves the derived `--ds-color-on-error` (2 channels), while bithire/evnto instead generate a full 11-step shade ramp (`--ds-color-error-50` through `-900`, plus the base) from the same single entry -- a genuine, value-independent per-vertical asymmetry (rottay's own baseline seeds no ramp-generation branch for authored semantic colors; bithire/evnto's does), not a defect. `--ds-color-bg-overlay` moves as a single, clean channel on all 3 verticals with no cascade. Both channels baseline to `undefined` on an empty tokenOverrides document on all 3 verticals -- no coincidental-default risk (F4B-16's own class) for either. `--ds-surface-card`, the third declaredOutputs entry, was measured but NOT chosen as a stop candidate: authoring it cascades to 8 channels including 10 chart-category series colors (`--ds-chart-series-1..10` odd/even split observed; a real categorical-palette-generation side effect of naming the card surface, not a bug) -- too broad for a single-entry causal attribution, though legitimate as a `representativeOnly` declaration. `--ds-line-height-body`, a genuinely non-colour allowlisted channel (TENANT_THEME_OVERRIDE_TOKENS, tenant-theme/index.ts:211; schema type `number({min:0.5,max:3})`), also moves cleanly and in isolation (neighbour `--ds-line-height-heading` stays `undefined` on both sides) -- cited as an additional class-coverage fact per the brief's own preference, not declared as a stop (would need its own domain-kind resolution, same gap). An out-of-allowlist key (`--ds-color-not-a-real-channel-xyz`) is REJECTED outright by schema validation (`Field is not part of TenantThemeConfig v1`, a thrown TenantThemeValidationError) -- the compiler does not silently elide it, it refuses the whole document. Max entries is exactly 200 (limits.maxTokenOverrides), confirmed by a 201-entry document throwing the count violation alongside the per-key rejections. `--ds-color-error` and `--ds-color-bg-overlay` are BOTH absent from the closed TEXT_CONTRAST_PAIRINGS list (branding-contrast/text-contrast-autocorrect/index.ts:97-188) that gates authored colors through the compiler's own dark-mode APCA floor (tenant-theme/index.ts:2086-2094, `validateCompiledThemeContrast` throws `TenantThemeValidationError` when it fires) -- so neither chosen channel can trip that validator at any authored value, which is the honest P3 answer for THIS measured scene: the allowlist DOES contain other channels that are APCA-paired (`--ds-color-text-primary`, the button-variant `-color` tokens, several `--ds-material-*-foreground*` roles), so the P3 concern is real for the control as a whole, just not for the two representative channels this packet measured.
calibration.familyLandingNote: Seated at primitive/feedback/alert.json rather than button.json (the brief's own steer): --ds-color-error/--ds-color-on-error are semantically alert/danger-state chrome, and alert.json's own cell already carries the control's universal ESCAPE_HATCH targetBinding scaffold (identical across effectively every family manifest -- adjudicatedFrom controls/token-overrides.json, socketsExpected:false), same as every other family's cell for this control. No family 'reaches' this control differently from any other by design; alert.json is the most honest landing site for THIS packet's two chosen channels, not evidence that the control is scoped to alerts.
